speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development in respect of the NCSS Social Service Sector Salary Guidelines (a) what is the percentage of social service agencies currently paying their employees in accordance with these recommendations; and (b) what specific measures are being taken to support the other agencies which have not met the salary guidelines to close the wage gap.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: SSAs should also review and adjust their operational budgets, so they can sustainably meet operational needs.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: In the next few years, we will further step up measures to increase adherence.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Has MSF studied the relationship between wage non-compliance and staff turnover, vacancy rates or case load pressures?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Because these issues as a whole, may cause workforce instability, which may in turn pose a risk to service delivery to beneficiaries.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: And secondly, how is MSF ensuring that smaller community-based SSAs are not disproportionately affected, given that they may have a weaker fundraising capability compared to the larger agencies?

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Of course, we will listen to the ground when there are specific areas which need more resources or more intents by nature of the locality.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: We will then support, perhaps even a bespoke way.
